title: too-many-branches (R0912) — function(s) at line 101
detail: A function has more branches than pylint's threshold. High branch count multiplies test cases needed for coverage and makes the function a defect magnet. Fix: extract decision clusters into named helper functions.

title: Builtin `id` shadowed by local variable (W0622)
detail: Local variable(s) at lines 45, 101 shadow the builtin(s) id. If the builtin is needed elsewhere in the same scope, the shadowing causes a confusing `TypeError` or silent misbehavior. Fix: rename the local variable to avoid shadowing.
